comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Released in the Valentine's Day Premium Bottle (2/8). Stats:

+2 Dye Trading
+2 Storage
+1 Provisions

No other dye-trading weapon slot items exist in the game apart from this, even in East Asian servers like Japan. Might seem useless, but it's all in how you use it.

Source: wiki.ogplanet.com/uwo/index.php?title=Valentine's_Day_Premium_Bottle
